narr: A nearly stationary boundary oriented from north to south set up over the area. Showers and thunderstorms developed along the boundary. Storm motion was also north to south, which allowed for storms to train over the same locations, resulting in instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Weems Lane was closed due to flooding from high water.
Thompson Hollow Road was closed due to flooding.
Rocky Hollow Road was closed due to flooding.
The 900 Block of Longs Road was closed due to Big Run Creek being out of its banks.
